# Mark´s Marks

> A free, open-source, offline Windows notes app for any kind of text notes,
> clipboard screenshots, local video attachments, and quick desktop access.

Mark´s Marks 1.0.0 is a standalone Windows executable licensed under MIT.
It requires .NET Framework 4.5 or newer; 4.8 is recommended. English is the
default interface language, with optional Czech.

It is suitable for quick ideas, task lists, meeting notes, reference material,
and personal or work notes while using other Windows programs. Images and videos
can be saved alongside notes to keep text and visual context together.
Open or hide the editor with Ctrl+Alt+N, its floating transparent logo, or the
system tray icon. Notes are plain UTF-8 files in user-selected local folders.

Paste images with Ctrl+V; add supported local videos. Attachment viewers provide
zoom, navigation, renaming, and confirmed deletion. Notes and attachments transfer
together through ZIP export/import. Transfer creates independent copies, without live
synchronization. Video playback depends on Windows codecs.

## Official resources

- [Repository and user guide](https://github.com/MarekFolwarczny/marks-marks): features, requirements, storage, and usage.
- [Download version 1.0.0](https://github.com/MarekFolwarczny/marks-marks/releases/tag/v1.0.0): Windows executable and ZIP.
- [Developer guide](https://github.com/MarekFolwarczny/marks-marks/blob/main/DEVELOPERS.md): architecture, build, tests, and practical limits.
- [MIT license](https://github.com/MarekFolwarczny/marks-marks/blob/main/LICENSE): personal and commercial use, modification, and redistribution.
